entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet restore does not work with slnx which contain websites #48968
  • version 8.0.409 is breaking dotnet format commands using sdk from docker executor #48957
  • EnableWindowsTargeting is broken in .NET 10 Preview 4 (Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App.Ref not found) #48949
  • Bug: ExcludeAssets="contentFiles" on <ProjectReference> does not prevent CopyToOutputDirectory items from being copied in .NET SDK 9.0.200 #48945
  • DependencyContent.*.RuntimeLibraries is returning libraries that are not used during runtime (code analyzers, build tasks, etc) #48944
  • SDK Container publish fails on transient HTTP download error #48940
  • [NETSDKE2E][ARM64][VMR]Using .NET 10 Preview 5 x64 SDK on ARM64 OS causes ".NET Host has stopped working" error. #48939
